about: Skills that the host lists to every session whatever HOME holds: built into Claude Code, or attached by the claude.ai account the session logs in with. A clean room cannot remove these, so the clean-room check allows them. Each Claude Code version adds to the list, taken from a session started with an empty HOME. The claude.ai account skills appear only when the session logs in with that account; an API-key session does not list them. `claude_code_agents` are the subagent types the host builds in (the `builtInTypes` of its agent listing); a run may spawn these, and any other subagent type needs `--allow`.
